q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT F1.FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 INNER JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER ORDER BY F1.FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT F1.FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F2.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 INNER JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWER = F2.FOLLOWEE GROUP BY F1.FOLLOWER ORDER BY F1.FOLLOWER
explanation: Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee who is also a follower of someone else, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each follower who is followed by someone else.
counterexample_dsp: A user A who follows user B, and user B who follows user A. Q1 will count user A as following user B, while Q2 will not count user A as following user B because user B is not a follower of anyone else.
